Children’s menus – great taste for the little ones

We’ve created special children’s menus for our youngest guests. These menus are designed to meet the needs and preferences of young travelers.

View my bookings

{spacer-40}

style
stage

Food to delight and excite your little ones: With our lovingly compiled children's menus, even the youngest passengers on board are well catered for. All meals are specially tailored to the needs and preferences of children – they are delicious, balanced and served in a child-friendly way. Children's menus can be booked directly at no extra cost when you book any long-haul flight.

{spacer-25}

Order children's menus up to 24 hours before departure

Please remember to pre-order the desired children’s menu up to 24 hours before departure. Through your pre-selection, we can ensure that the requested menu is available for your child. You will also help us to plan more sustainably.

{spacer-25}

Why is pre-ordering important? {full-width}

If you do not pre-order the children's menu up to 24 hours before departure, we unfortunately cannot guarantee that the desired meal will be available on board. In this case, your child will receive a regular menu. {full-width}

Order now

Kids Box on European flights

We spoil our youngest passengers on European flights too – with the Onboard Delights Kids Box. The Kids Box contains a selection of child-appropriate, delicious snacks and can be easily pre-ordered up to 24 hours before departure for a fee.

Culinary Journey

Catering on board: tailored completely to your wishes

Journeys start with anticipation – including for the food and drinks you can enjoy on board. You can find all our culinary services in one place – transparent, personal and inspiring – where you can experience a diverse, high-quality service that focuses on your personal wishes. Whether it’s small snacks or exquisite menus of an award-winning standard, you can look forward to a lavish selection offering you unforgettable taste experiences above the clouds.

To Culinary Journey

{spacer-40}

Baby food {column-start}

For our youngest passengers, we offer a selection of food such as baby food jars, mini sausages, and soups, depending on availability on board. We recommend that you bring your child's favorite baby food jars or bottles on board with you. Our cabin crew will be happy to warm these up for you. {column-end}

More information about our in-flight menus {heading-small}

Special Meals

Passengers who require a special meal for diet, religion or health reasons receive a varied range of services.

Travel classes

On Lufthansa short-haul and medium-haul flights, we serve a variety of meals and beverages in all our travel classes.
